_comment: Mission 1, Scene 3: the line. Walk-over triggers start it at 'arrive', 'sign', 'pocket' and 'stop' (in that order). Events: dog_enters (the handler and dog start down the line), dog_reaches_mateo and dog_passes (wait: the scene resumes when the dog gets there), hand_to_jacket, dog_leaves (they walk on, off the line), open_envelope and envelope_put_away (wait), line_moves (Mateo walks to the booth).

arrive.text: The pedestrian line runs under a long metal awning. It's already hot.

arrive2.text: A woman fans herself with a store flyer. A man ahead holds a sleeping boy on his shoulder. Two teenagers share a pair of earbuds.

sign.text: A sign on the wall: BORDER CROSSING CARD HOLDERS: EMPLOYMENT NOT AUTHORIZED.

pocket.text: Mateo checks his pocket. His passport, and his border crossing card.

dog.text: An officer walks a dog slowly down the line. The dog sniffs a cooler, a stroller, a shopping bag.

hand.text: Mateo's hand goes to his jacket. He moves it away.

passed.text: The dog passes him without stopping.

open1.text: He turns away from the line and slides a thumb under the flap. The signature tears down the middle.

open2.text: Inside: three sheets of paper, folded once. All of them blank.

open3.text: He folds them back in and puts the envelope away.
